svg.text: A declaration under a reclaimed worktree, and the tree it was resolved against
The run's worktree directory is removed after the worker commits; the recorded path survives on the run record.
Run pointer
worktree: …/ship-xxxx/worktree
recorded, but the directory is gone
repo: …/Code/reckon
exists; promotion's readable-tree fallback
node.write_paths: ["…/worktree/docs/figures/x"]
granted absolutely, under the vanished worktree
changed: docs/figures/x/scope.svg
Before — each surface resolved against a different tree
write-time check · check-manifest
resolve against the recorded worktree
→ docs/figures/x
in scope — no finding
promotion · _outside_declared_scope
resolve against the fallback tree = repo
→ no root (declaration is under the worktree)
stray — the same declaration is refused
The declaration is right and the run is sound. The later surface lost the worktree only because the directory is gone, and the grant no longer maps
to any repository-relative root, so the two disagree on one unchanged manifest.
After — both resolve against the recorded worktree
worktree = record["worktree"] or tree
the recorded path is the authority whether or not it exists on disk
write-time check: accepted
promotion: accepted
Falsified by resolving promotion against the fallback tree instead: 6 failed, 20 passed — the five declared cases and the named acceptance case go red,
while the undeclared-path rejection and the intact-worktree cases stay green.
